contract: exploration-note-authoring0.1.0 draft; authored document output only

declared_deterministic_cases.scope: Declared structure/golden assertions, not model behavior; native helper tests run separately.

portable_generated_helper.scope: Actual generated package copied outside Aether; Python-I with repository-pinned PyYAML checks actual canary/local references.

native_controls: Create-only scaffold creates then unchanged repeat is a no-op
Authored revision retains stable ID and correction; rerun refuses overwrite
Park requires no issue/deadline; linked downstream task leaves note draft
Duplicate identity preserves both contributions and blocks collection validation
Conflicting architecture remains hypothesis; accepted/authority escalation metadata refused
Missing local source returns partial; no inferred truth or external fetching
Private-to-public source admission, duplicate metadata and unsafe references refused
Symlink/missing parent directory refused; generic CLI diagnostics withhold source content

canary.review_scope: Actual authored source, public facts/links, attribution, privacy, tentative authority and future projection boundary

limitations: The convention is optional draft authoring guidance and a consumer-owned Markdown output, not a new first-party artifact kind or organization lifecycle policy. No fleet installation, forced migration, issue promotion, garden ingestion or public deployment occurs.

The Aether canary is reviewed by Codex for source/authority/privacy and stays draft/parked. It supplies no human architectural acceptance, usefulness measurement, model effectiveness or organization applicability decision.

The helper checks bounded metadata and available local source paths; external references, source truth, private prose classification and actual review require independent verification. Authored edits and normal Git review own revisions; no archive or ingestion engine is added.

Mindgarden39 is closed not-planned as actually observed; it is historical context, not an active prerequisite. Existing downstream owner work remains separate. The real consumer/release gate under38 stays not-ready, with 11 existing optional/native skips explicit.
decision_impact: ADR not required: implements the requested optional authored document output through existing specification/skill kinds; adds no public schema, global lifecycle policy, new owner, service or authorization.
